purpose: Track the remaining proof required before IsleMind can expose image/video generation as an executable mobile action.

mustNotClaimDefaultReadinessUntil: every proof row status is captured
native mobile generation UI proof is captured on device
artifact manifest, retention cleanup, and cancellation semantics are covered by runtime evidence

requiredEvidence: model-level image/video generation metadata
sourceUrl for the provider/model capability claim
verifiedAt date for the provider/model capability claim
test coverage proving provider-wide and inferred-only claims stay blocked
acceptanceCriteria: source-backed model metadata can advance only provider-capability-evidence
provider-wide imageGeneration/videoGeneration declarations remain unsafe overclaims
default readiness is at most 1/6 when this is the only captured proof

requiredEvidence: provider-specific generation request adapter
normalized progress, success, cancellation, and error states
feature-gated executable plan replacing the disabled adapter plan
no raw prompt, provider URI, or base64 payload persistence outside the artifact manifest rules
acceptanceCriteria: MEDIA_GENERATION_ADAPTER_IMPLEMENTED remains false while this row is blocked
buildDisabledMediaGenerationAdapterPlan keeps canExecute false while this row is blocked
no composer image/video generation execution action is exposed before this row is captured

requiredEvidence: real generated image artifact manifest
real generated video artifact manifest when video generation is targeted
localUri storage only
byte-size and dimension budgets
promptDigest without rawPrompt or base64Data
audit event id, native proof id, and full gate id checklist
acceptanceCriteria: artifact manifests do not imply default readiness without cleanup, cancellation, native proof, provider evidence, and adapter implementation

requiredEvidence: ephemeral generated artifact cleanup is scheduled or completed
user-saved generated artifact retention is explicit and does not require cleanup
temporary provider payloads and raw provider URIs are not retained
cleanup evidence links back to the generated artifact manifest
acceptanceCriteria: ephemeral artifacts without expiresAt and cleanupState stay blocked
runtime privacy-retention checks cover generated artifact cleanup before default enablement

requiredEvidence: AbortController or equivalent cancellation handle is linked to each generation request
mobile cancel action stops the provider request or records provider non-cancellability explicitly
partial artifacts are either cleaned up or recorded as cancelled artifacts
artifact manifest records requestId, cancellation state, and cancellation linkage
acceptanceCriteria: cancelled requests do not leave orphaned temporary generated media
generation cannot be default-enabled without visible mobile cancellation semantics

requiredEvidence: ADB screenshot proof for the generation UI before default enablement
320dp Chat generation request/progress/cancel state is readable and unclipped
360dp Agent generation request/progress/cancel/evidence state is readable and unclipped
native result records package focus, viewport metadata, screenshot dimensions, and zero fatal logcat errors
acceptanceCriteria: current boundary-status native proof is not treated as generation execution proof
native proof stays pending until an actual generation UI surface exists behind the completed gates
no composer image/video generation execution action is exposed before this proof is captured

mustNotExposeBeforeAllProofRowsCaptured: automatic generation execution from locked capability notices
